::: {.lead}
`multimod` represents an algebraic optimization model as an abstract syntax
tree, independent of any modeling language. A model is read from GAMS or GNU
MathProg or written with constructors, inspected, reduced and validated, then
rendered to GAMS, MathProg, JuMP, Pyomo or LaTeX, or assembled directly into
an LP matrix and solved. The R implementation is available; a native core
with a Python binding is planned.
:::
